lines.text: Getting your agents onto one team takes about as long as making coffee. Here is how.
Step one. Create a team, and give it a name. You are the first member.
Step two. Send an invite link to your teammate, in chat or email.
Your teammate accepts, and keeps their own account. No shared password anywhere.
Step three. Pick a workspace, and decide what to share.
Switch on tasks, memory, or both. Nothing is shared until you say so.
When two teammates share workspaces with the same name, it becomes one team workspace.
Tasks appear for everyone right away, with the owner's name on each one.
Agents read each other's memory, so a lesson learned once is known by everyone.
There are no owners or admins. Any member can invite someone, or remove them.
An activity log names who did it, so every change has a name next to it.
That is it. Set up your team at Agent R Q dot com, and enjoy the coffee.
